evidence: Touches JSONRPCRequest parsing in src/rpc/request.cpp and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
rationale: Fixes an edge-case JSON-RPC specification violation where malformed non-object elements in a batch request inherit the ID and version of the previous element. When a batch element is invalid, parse() throws before resetting state, leading to duplicate response IDs or improperly dropped errors for JSON-RPC 2.0 notifications.
